title: Checkout latency spike during evening peak
symptom: p95 latency rose from 300ms to 4s and checkout errors reached 6%
root_cause: Database connection pool exhausted after a config change lowered max connections from 100 to 20
fix: Restored max connections to 100 and added an alert on pool saturation
outcome: Latency back to baseline within 10 minutes of the fix
notes: 18:20 alert fired; 18:40 traced to pool wait time; 19:00 config rolled back

title: Payment webhooks delayed
symptom: Webhook queue depth grew to 40k and customer receipts arrived up to an hour late
root_cause: A deploy shipped a retry loop without backoff so failing webhooks were retried immediately and starved the queue
fix: Rolled back the deploy and added exponential backoff to webhook retries
